column1: # Traduzione inglese dei testi del corso Tongji (ultime frasi da riordinare e domande, lezioni 1-11).

column2: The tutoring sessions start next week.
This film is quite interesting.
Thank you for your concern!
I’ll go for a little walk with you.
I’ve caught a bad cold.
You really are a good student.
At the weekend I usually go shopping.
I do sport almost every day.
Because it was raining, we didn’t go.
He’s on the school table tennis team.
At eight I was in class.
How did you get here?
As long as you practise a lot, you’ll learn well.
It’ll be the weekend soon.
The school is ten kilometres from here.
Weren’t you off on your trip?
I thought you had gone back to your country.
What’s best to wear?
This top is a bit tight.
I tried on several, but none of them fit.
Never mind, I won’t buy it.
When you go out, take your coat.
There are four of us in my family.
He looks a lot like his father.
This is a photo of our whole family.
How are you planning to spend the winter holidays?
As soon as class finishes I go to the library.
You can take either the train or the plane, it’s all the same.
First we’ll go to Xi’an, then to Beijing.
Happy New Year!
Which of these is an initial (声母)?
zh is an initial; ai, ong and üe are finals.
zh
ai
ong
üe
What tone does the syllable 「马」 mǎ (horse) have?
The mark ˇ shows the 3rd tone.
3rd tone
1st tone
2nd tone
4th tone
Which of these syllables has the 4th tone?
The mark ˋ shows the 4th tone.
bà
bā
bá
bǎ
Which pair contrasts an unaspirated initial with an aspirated one?
b is pronounced without a puff of air, p with one.
b – p
m – f
n – l
s – sh
Where is the tone mark written in a syllable?
The tone always goes on the main vowel.
Above the main vowel
Above the initial
At the end of the syllable
It is never written
Someone says 「谢谢！」 to you. What do you answer?
To 谢谢 you answer 不客气 (you’re welcome).
How do you greet a classmate?
你好 = hello / good morning.
Which of these is a nasal final?
ang ends with the nasal sound -ng.
ang
ou
ie
Which word has the retroflex final (儿化)?
儿化 is written by adding -r to the syllable.
玩儿 wánr
完 wán
万 wàn
晚 wǎn
Which pair differs only in -n / -ng?
Only fān/fāng changes just the final nasal.
fān – fāng
fān – fēn
fā – fān
fāng – fēng
You want to ask the price. What do you say?
多少钱 = how much is it?
The teacher speaks too fast and you want her to repeat. What do you say?
请再说一遍 = please say it again.
Someone says 「对不起！」 to you. What do you answer?
To 对不起 you answer 没关系 (it doesn’t matter).
「我听不懂。」 means…
听不懂 = I hear it but I don’t understand.
I don’t understand (what I hear).
I can’t hear you.
I don’t want to listen.
I understand.
How is 「你好」 pronounced?
Two 3rd tones: the first is pronounced as a 2nd tone.
ní hǎo
nǐ hǎo with two full 3rd tones
nī hǎo
nì hǎo
How is 「一天」 (one day) pronounced?
Before a 1st tone 一 becomes yì.
yì tiān
yí tiān
yī tiān
yǐ tiān
How is 「一块」 (one yuan) pronounced?
Before a 4th tone 一 becomes yí.
yí kuài
yì kuài
yī kuài
yǐ kuài
How is 「不去」 (not to go) pronounced?
Before a 4th tone 不 becomes bú.
bú qù
bù qù
bū qù
bǔ qù
How is 「不好」 (not good) pronounced?
Before a 3rd tone 不 stays bù.
bù hǎo
bú hǎo
bū hǎo
bǔ hǎo
How do you write the syllable “i” with the 1st tone and no initial?
Without an initial, i is written yi.
yī
wī
yū
How do you write j + ü with the 3rd tone (举, to raise)?
After j, q, x the dots on ü are not written.
jǔ
jǚ
jiǔ
zhǔ
How do you write l + ü with the 4th tone (绿, green)?
After l and n, ü keeps its dots.
lǜ
lù
liù
lǚ
How do you write n + iou with the 2nd tone (牛, cow)?
iou after an initial becomes iu; the tone goes on the u.
niú
nióu
nioú
nú
In which word does the second syllable have the neutral tone?
In repeated family words the second syllable is neutral.
妈妈 māma
老师 lǎoshī
今天 jīntiān
学校 xuéxiào
The seller asks too high a price. What do you say?
太贵了 + 便宜一点儿吧 to bargain.
Someone greets you with 「你好！」. What do you answer?
You answer the greeting 你好 with 你好.
You are asked 「你叫什么名字？」. Which is the correct answer?
You answer with 我叫 + name.
「我叫杰夫，你呢？」 What are they asking you?
呢 repeats the question: here it asks your name.
Your name.
How you are.
Where you are from.
Where you are.
You want to say “We are all international students”. Which sentence is correct?
都 goes after the subject and before the verb.
Which sentence means “She is our teacher”?
A 的 B = “A’s B”.
You are asked 「你也是美国人吗？」 and you are American. What do you answer?
To confirm: 对，我是 / 是，我也是美国人.
You are asked 「你多大？」. Which is the correct answer?
Age: 我 + number + 岁, without 是.
You are asked 「他是谁？」. Which is a suitable answer?
谁 asks who the person is.
Which sentence means “I’m in class 3”?
在 + class/place = to be in.
The answer is 「我是法国人。」. What was the question?
It asked about nationality.
How do you say 35?
Tens (三十) + units (五).
You are asked 「现在几点？」 and it’s 2:00. What do you answer?
Before 点 you say 两.
You are asked 「今天星期几？」. Which is the correct answer?
Days: 星期 + number (二, not 两).
You are asked 「明天你有课吗？」 and you have no class. What do you answer?
What time is it when you hear 「差一刻九点」?
It’s a quarter to nine.
It’s 23:30 and you have an early class tomorrow. What does your classmate tell you?
该 + verb + 了: it’s time to go to bed.
How do you say 1:15?
一刻 = a quarter of an hour.
Someone says 「谢谢你！」 to you. What do you answer?
You are asked 「你们的学校大吗？」. Which is the correct answer?
Adjective as predicate with 很, without 是.
You are asked 「请问，二班的教室在这儿吗？」 and it’s right here. What do you answer?
You confirm with 对，在这儿.
Which sentence means “The pen is under the book”?
Thing + 在 + reference point + 的 + 下边.
The answer is 「在那个教室的旁边。」. What was the question?
It asked about a place (哪儿).
How do you read the price ¥7.50?
块 + 毛; the last unit can be dropped.
How do you read the price ¥15.40?
15 块 and 4 毛 → 十五块四.
You are asked 「你要哪个？」 and you want that one there. What do you answer?
那个 = that one.
Which measure word is used for 「自行车」?
For vehicles you use 辆.
How do you say 340?
You are asked 「黑的怎么样？」 but you don’t like black. What do you answer?
You express a preference with 喜欢 / 不喜欢.
The waiter says 「一共二十块。」. What does it mean?
一共 = altogether.
It’s 20 yuan altogether.
Each one costs 20 yuan.
20 yuan are missing.
It’s more than 20 yuan.
You are asked whether you bought the shoes, but you didn’t. What do you say?
The negative of a past action is 没(有) + verb, without 了.
How do you read the room number 601?
Digit by digit; 1 is read yāo.
liù líng yāo
liùbǎi líng yī
liùshíyī
liù líng qī
You answer the phone and are asked 「是安妮吗？」. It’s you. What do you say?
是我 = it’s me.
A friend has a birthday. What do you say?
祝你生日快乐 = happy birthday.
You want to suggest going together. Which sentence do you use?
吧 = suggestion.
How do you reduplicate 「看」 to say “have a look”?
One-syllable verb: AA (or A一A).
You are asked 「你的生日是几月几号？」. Which answer is correct?
Dates go from big to small: month, then day.
A friend phones you: 「你有什么事？」. What is he asking you?
有什么事 = is something up? what do you need?
Why you called him / what you need.
What you own.
What your job is.
What you ate.
A classmate seems unwell. What do you ask him?
你怎么了 = what’s wrong?
You arrive late to class. What do you say as you come in?
You apologise with 对不起.
The teacher says 「你怎么才来？」. What does she mean?
才 = later than expected.
Why are you only getting here now?
Why did you come?
When will you come?
Someone knocks on your office door. What do you say?
请进 = come in!
Which sentence means “I have toothache”?
In 「她病了。」 what does 了 show?
了 at the end of a sentence = new situation.
A change: now she is ill.
The future.
A question.
Possession.
Tomorrow you have to go to the embassy and can’t come to class. What do you tell the teacher?
请假 = to ask for leave.
A friend asks you 「你能吃完吗？」 and you’re sure you can. What do you answer?
没问题 = no problem.
Which question is correct?
With A不A you don’t add 吗.
Your host asks you 「你喝茶还是喝咖啡？」. What do you answer?
You choose one of the two options.
How many grams are 「一斤」?
一斤 = half a kilo.
At the market you want to taste the grapes. What do you ask?
可以 to ask for permission.
You have guests and invite them to sit down. What do you say?
请坐 = please sit down.
The seller says 「我们这儿不讲价。」. What does it mean?
讲价 = to bargain.
No bargaining here.
No talking here.
It’s not expensive here.
Nothing is sold here.
Someone knocks at the door. How do you ask who it is?
谁 = who.
You are asked 「你干什么呢？」 and you’re doing your homework. What do you answer?
Verb + object + 呢 = action in progress.
You’re talking to your classmate: you want to say “let’s go, just the two of us”. Which pronoun do you use?
咱们 always includes the listener.
A friend tells you some incredible news. What do you answer?
真的吗 = really?
「我有点儿想家。」 means…
想家 = to miss home.
I want to buy a house.
I’m thinking a bit about school.
I’ve been home for a while.
Which sentence describes an action in progress?
呢 shows an action in progress.
Which sentence is correct?
有点儿 goes before the adjective.
